# `usage_record`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

One usage record from the network feed (TMF635 ProductUsage): data, voice or SMS used on a line, stored once per network record id and matched to the product that held the number on the event date. Not rated here (pay-as-you-go rating is a later slice).

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `network_record_id` | `text` | no |  | The network's own record id: the idempotency key, a resent batch stores nothing twice. |
| `kind` | `text` | no |  | data, voice or sms (the usage specification). |
| `quantity` | `bigint` | no |  | Data in bytes, voice in seconds, sms in messages; always positive. |
| `roaming` | `boolean` | no | `false` |  |
| `throttled` | `boolean` | no | `false` | The network reported the line as throttled at this record. |
| `msisdn` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `imsi` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `event_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the usage happened, from the network. |
| `event_date` | `date` | no |  | The business date (billing time zone) of event_at: the date that selects the product and the plan period. |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The product holding the MSISDN (or IMSI) on event_date through number assignment history; null when no line held it. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `status` | `text` | no |  | TMF635 status: notRated (matched, not rated: a plan line's included usage, or waiting for its day to close), rated (a pay-as-you-go line's usage, charged or without a usage price) or rejected (no line held the number). |
| `rejection_reason` | `text` | yes |  | noLine when the record could not be matched. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
